text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in agent/tool invocations detected on hosted-api us-west-2. 99th p50 token latency up, error 503s rising. auto-escalating to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:

andrew (oncall): paging in. seeing sustained fncall rate ~5x baseline for the last 3m. looks correlated with /v1/chat route.

sara (eng-sre): confirm. I can see growth in total open kv cache and long-tail latency on a subset of backends (g3-rt-pool). error msgs: `tool invocation timeout` repeated.

mike (eng-runtime): logs show tool proxies saturating. quick fix options: 1) global soft-limit on function calls, 2) disable structured output (json) on noisy tenants, 3) per-tenant quota enforcement.

jordan (product): impact? which customers hit? need to know if any paid tenants affected before disabling features.

emily (cs): we have two active tickets from enterprise customers complaining about failed tool calls in last 10m (T-2241, T-2242). both are on Dedicated but some are hitting hosted fallback.

andrew (oncall): immediate mitigation: apply soft quota to reduce fncall concurrency and fallback to plain text streaming when fncall limit reached. will also add a route-level rate cap for the offending route.

sara (eng-sre): i'm going to push a temporary policy. command I'll run:
```
# soft-quarantine: limit function calls per api-key to 10 concurrent, fallback to text
rctl policy update --scope=hosted --route=/v1/chat --set fncall_concurrency=10 --fallback=plain_text
```
Should we also flip structured-output off platform-wide?

mike (eng-runtime): prefer scoped change first. platform-wide kills a lot of valid workloads. do per-route then per-tenant. I'll pre-create a rollback: `rctl policy rollback --id=soft-quarantine-1758804321`

andrew (oncall): proceed with scoped route change, then watch 1m. sara you have the keys?

sara (eng-sre): running now. `deploy-bot` will emit event.

deploy-bot: POLICY_UPDATE_STARTED: soft-quarantine-1758804321 by sara (eng-sre) on /v1/chat

sara (eng-sre): done. policy applied. metrics: fncall concurrency per-key cap enforced. fallback configured.

mike (eng-runtime): seeing immediate drop in proxy queue length. 50p latency back to normal within 30s. some clients receiving warnings in the stream that their function calls were suppressed. sample proxy log:
```
WARN  proxy: fncall_quota_exceeded api_key=acct_ABC123 route=/v1/chat allowed=10 requested=18
INFO  runtime: falling back to plain_text_stream for request id=req_0a1b
```

jordan (product): good. need messaging for affected customers: please tag any enterprise impacted. emily can we draft a short note: what happened, what we did, what to expect.

emily (cs): on it. will include ETA for rollback and links to telemetry.

andrew (oncall): next: evaluate per-tenant rate tweak for top offenders. sara, can you dump top 10 api keys by fncall volume in last 10m?

sara (eng-sre): running query, results in ~30s.

sara (eng-sre): top offenders: acct_ABC123, acct_XYZ789, acct_TEN33. I'll apply a stricter quota to those three and leave route cap for others. command:
```
rctl quota set --api-key=acct_ABC123 --fncall_concurrency=5 --note="auto-mitigation 1758804321"
```

andrew (oncall): good. mike monitor errors downstream. i'll update incident channel and set handoff if spike persists.

mike (eng-runtime): after tenant caps: proxy queue stable, 503s dropping. overall error rate back to baseline ~2m after changes.

jordan (product): product note: we should avoid turning off structured output for customers who rely on JSON tool responses. do a targeted suppression only.

andrew (oncall): decision logged: scoped route cap + per-tenant/fncall concurrency caps + plain text fallback. no global disable.

emily (cs): drafted customer message and posted to affected tickets; will send email to enterprise owners if they request.

sara (eng-sre): creating follow-up task to add a realtime alert: high fncall rate per-route with auto-recommend mitigation steps. ticket: INF-4325.

andrew (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 20m. summary to hand off:
- root: sudden surge of tool/agent invocations from a small set of keys overloaded tool proxies
- action taken: route-level fncall_concurrency=10 + fallback=plain_text; tightened 3 tenant caps to concurrency=5
- immediate result: latency and 503s returned to baseline; customers notified; tickets updated
- follow-ups: INF-4325 alerting, post-incident runbook item for graceful structured-output degradation

andrew (oncall): @mike @sara please ping me if we see fncall rate > 2x baseline or 503 rate rises above 0.5% in next 2h. handing off now. :white_check_mark:

mike (eng-runtime): ack, i'll keep an eye and escalate if needed.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation in place). duration: ~32m. incident channel archived to incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/1758804321
